notes.text: Section 1266, act Sept. 3, 1954, ch. 1257, title III, § 329, 68 Stat. 1163, related to disposition of general officers ceasing to occupy position. See section 14314(a) of Title 10, Armed Forces.
Section 1267, act Sept. 3, 1954, ch. 1257, title III, § 330, 68 Stat. 1163, related to excess numbers in grade. See sections 14514 and 14704 of Title 10.
